description: Takes an export with one row per case (requisition, order number, cost centre, requester, supplier, order value, value received, value invoiced, block, date) and puts every row into one status from its fields: invoice waiting for goods receipt (red), blocked (red), open to order, open to receive, goods receipt without invoice, or done. Returns count and value per status, open cases per cost centre, and the next steps sorted by urgency and age, each with who has to act (purchasing, the requester or accounting) and what to do. To check a single invoice against order and goods receipt use match_documents. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

as_of.description: Reference date for the age in days, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

rows.description: One row per case: requisition, order, cost_center, requester, supplier, value, received, invoiced, blocked (reason or empty), date. German column names work too (anforderung, bestellung, kostenstelle, besteller, lieferant, wert, geliefert, berechnet, gesperrt, datum). A row without an order number counts as not yet ordered.

name: order_to_payment_status
title: Order-to-payment status overview: from one export what is stuck where, per cost centre, with the next step and who has to act
